import datetime,json,math,pathlib,statistics,subprocess,sys
root=pathlib.Path('/tmp/klickr-live-strict')
adb=['adb','-s','emulator-5582']
def run(*args): return subprocess.check_output(adb+list(args),text=True).strip()
def cpu(pid):
 raw=run('exec-out','run-as','com.buzbuz.smartautoclicker.debug','cat',f'/proc/{pid}/stat')
 fields=raw[raw.rfind(') ')+2:].split()
 return int(fields[11])+int(fields[12]),raw
def json_lines(text):
 values=[]
 for line in text.splitlines():
  try: value=json.loads(line.strip())
  except ValueError: continue
  if isinstance(value,dict): values.append(value)
 return values
round_id,mode=int(sys.argv[2]),sys.argv[3]
prefix=root/f'round-{round_id}-{mode}'
meta=pathlib.Path(str(prefix)+'-meta.json')
if sys.argv[1]=='before':
 pid=int(run('shell','pidof','com.buzbuz.smartautoclicker.debug'))
 target=int(run('shell','pidof','com.buzbuz.smartautoclicker.core.script.android.test'))
 ticks,raw=cpu(pid)
 p={'round':round_id,'mode':mode,'device':'emulator-5582','appPid':pid,'targetPid':target,'startedAtUtc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'startDelayMs':20000,'clockTicksPerSecond':int(run('shell','getconf','CLK_TCK')),'cpuBeforeTicks':ticks,'cpuBeforeRaw':raw}
 meta.write_text(json.dumps(p,indent=2)+'\n')
 print('Prepared',prefix.name)
else:
 p=json.loads(meta.read_text())
 projection=run('shell','dumpsys','media_projection')
 assert 'null' in projection,projection
 ticks,raw=cpu(p['appPid']);p.update(cpuAfterTicks=ticks,cpuAfterRaw=raw,endedAtUtc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat())
 p['cpuMsIncludingConsentStartupWaitAndCleanup']=(ticks-p['cpuBeforeTicks'])*1000/p['clockTicksPerSecond']
 meta.write_text(json.dumps(p,indent=2)+'\n')
 for suffix,args in [('dump',('shell','dumpsys','activity','service','com.buzbuz.smartautoclicker.debug/com.buzbuz.smartautoclicker.SmartAutoClickerService','--script-json')),('target',('shell','logcat','-d',f"--pid={p['targetPid']}",'-v','raw','-s','KlickrLatencyTarget:I','*:S')),('meminfo',('shell','dumpsys','meminfo',str(p['appPid'])))]:
  pathlib.Path(str(prefix)+f'-{suffix}.txt').write_text(run(*args)+'\n')
 events=json_lines(pathlib.Path(str(prefix)+'-dump.txt').read_text());target=json_lines(pathlib.Path(str(prefix)+'-target.txt').read_text())
 report=json.loads(next(e['message'] for e in events if e['kind']=='log' and 'latency_target_samples' in e['message']))
 assert len(report['rows'])==20
 assert [r[0] for r in report['rows']]==list(range(3,23))
 down={e['generation']:e for e in target if e['phase']=='down'};up={e['generation']:e for e in target if e['phase']=='up'}
 assert set(down)==set(up)==set(range(23)),(len(down),len(up))
 operations=[e for e in events if e['kind']=='operation']
 assert bool(operations)==(mode=='detailed'),len(operations)
 samples=[]
 for row in report['rows']:
  i,waiting,start,captured,recognized,end,frame=row;touch_down=down[i]['monotonicNanos']/1e6;touch_up=up[i]['monotonicNanos']/1e6
  assert waiting<=start<=captured<=recognized<=touch_down<=touch_up and end>=recognized,(row,touch_down,touch_up)
  samples.append({'iteration':i,'waitMs':start-waiting,'observationMs':captured-start,'recognitionMs':recognized-captured,'recognitionToTargetDownMs':touch_down-recognized,'gestureCallbackReturnMs':end-recognized,'observationStartToTargetDownMs':touch_down-start,'targetUpAfterGestureCallbackMs':touch_up-end})
 pathlib.Path(str(prefix)+'-joined.json').write_text(json.dumps({'report':report,'events':events,'targetEvents':target,'samples':samples},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
 ns=sorted(s['observationStartToTargetDownMs'] for s in samples)
 print(prefix.name,'touches',len(down),'retained operations',len(operations),'reaction p50/p95',round(statistics.median(ns),3),round(ns[math.ceil(.95*len(ns))-1],3),'CPU ms',p['cpuMsIncludingConsentStartupWaitAndCleanup'])

limitations: Synthetic flat colors and a 1 ms tap, not farm images/OCR or game response. No event-engine baseline for this live target.

Five rounds alternate which mode starts; normal starts three pairs and detailed starts two. The application process is reused; the target activity process is restarted per run. Cold early rounds differ from later rounds.
The script parameter round remains 1 in every run; logicalRound identifies the repeated host-controlled collections. Startup wait is explicitly supplied as 20000 ms in both modes.
observationMs includes the observe bridge and now clock calls. ImageReader may reuse its latest frame; this is not sensor/compositor capture latency or a guaranteed new frame.
waitMs includes waitFor observation/polling and clock calls. Previous target UP to next DOWN includes target redraw/capture availability, not only motor work.
Target DOWN/UP timestamps are taken in the target application callback; they include Android input dispatch and target main-thread scheduling. Draw logs do not prove presentation by SurfaceFlinger.
The gesture callback may return before the target processes UP. The script confirms the next color before continuing.

Host durations and residuals are available only for detailed events still retained within the 200-event history. Residuals include binding, serialization, clock-call and diagnostic-recording work; they are not pure JS bridge timings.

CPU is read from the application process /proc stat at 100 ticks/s. Its interval includes the final consent query, startup, the 20-second wait, warmup, tracing/UI, cleanup and idle time before collection. It does not isolate rendering CPU.
Memory is a post-cleanup dumpsys snapshot of the app process, not peak memory or per-operation allocations.
Only x86_64 API 36 was exercised here; this does not prove arm64 behavior or live farm completion.
gestureCallSpanMs is the span from the recognition clock marker through tap and the next clock marker, including binding/tracing. It is not a timestamp taken inside GestureResultCallback.
The imported strict ZIP is the source used by the main app; assets embedded in the target test APK are not used by this run.
failureDefinition: Aborted run, wrong measured-frame recognition or missing/duplicate/cancelled target touch. Expected not_found polls inside waitFor are not errors.
